tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, answer tiles, leaderboard rows, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, wells, segmented-control tracks, the frame around the drawing canvas.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, toggles). 3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint. 4.5:1+ everywhere it is used.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata (games played, timestamps) on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Spotflow indigo. Primary buttons, links, selected states, the active tab. As text it reads on surface, surface-raised and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the current player's leaderboard row, chips. Text on it is ink or primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Dark in the dark theme because the indigo lightens there.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px surface-coloured gap. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: game-quiz
tokens.usage: Quiz Arena identity fill: game tiles, the quiz timer ring, round headers.

tokens.name: game-quiz-soft
tokens.usage: Quiz Arena tinted backgrounds (lobby banner, results header). Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: game-quiz-ink
tokens.usage: Quiz Arena coloured text and icons on surface, surface-raised and game-quiz-soft.

tokens.name: on-game-quiz
tokens.usage: Text on a game-quiz fill, both themes.

tokens.name: game-draw
tokens.usage: Draw & Guess identity fill: game tiles, the drawer badge, round headers.

tokens.name: game-draw-soft
tokens.usage: Draw & Guess tinted backgrounds. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: game-draw-ink
tokens.usage: Draw & Guess coloured text and icons on surface, surface-raised and game-draw-soft.

tokens.name: on-game-draw
tokens.usage: Text on a game-draw fill, both themes.

tokens.name: game-truths
tokens.usage: Two Truths and a Lie identity fill: game tiles, the featured-player spotlight.

tokens.name: game-truths-soft
tokens.usage: Two Truths tinted backgrounds. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: game-truths-ink
tokens.usage: Two Truths coloured text and icons on surface, surface-raised and game-truths-soft.

tokens.name: on-game-truths
tokens.usage: Text on a game-truths fill, both themes.

tokens.name: game-clash
tokens.usage: Core Clash identity fill: game tiles, the arena frame.

tokens.name: game-clash-soft
tokens.usage: Core Clash tinted backgrounds. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: game-clash-ink
tokens.usage: Core Clash coloured text and icons on surface, surface-raised and game-clash-soft.

tokens.name: on-game-clash
tokens.usage: Text on a game-clash fill, both themes.

tokens.name: clash-team-0
tokens.usage: Core Clash team Blaze. Always paired with its circle shape.

tokens.name: clash-team-1
tokens.usage: Core Clash team Tide. Always paired with its square shape.

tokens.name: clash-team-2
tokens.usage: Core Clash team Volt. Always paired with its triangle shape.

tokens.name: clash-team-3
tokens.usage: Core Clash team Nova. Always paired with its diamond shape.

tokens.name: on-clash-team
tokens.usage: Text on any Core Clash team fill, both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answer, saved, connected. Blue-teal so it never depends on a red/green split. Always paired with a check icon and a word. Text on surface-raised and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of correct-answer tiles and success banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answer, errors, remove player, end session. Always paired with an X icon or a word. Text on surface-raised and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of wrong-answer tiles and error banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Timer under 5 seconds, reconnecting, expiring lobby. Always with a clock or alert icon. Text on surface-raised and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners.

tokens.name: medal-gold
tokens.usage: Rank 1 medal fill. The rank number is always printed inside it.

tokens.name: medal-silver
tokens.usage: Rank 2 medal fill. The rank number is always printed inside it.

tokens.name: medal-bronze
tokens.usage: Rank 3 medal fill. The rank number is always printed inside it.

tokens.name: on-medal
tokens.usage: Rank number on any medal fill.

tokens.name: avatar-bg-1
tokens.usage: Avatar builder background option 1 (peach). Same in both themes so an avatar looks identical everywhere; initials on it use avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-bg-2
tokens.usage: Avatar builder background option 2 (sky). Same in both themes so an avatar looks identical everywhere; initials on it use avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-bg-3
tokens.usage: Avatar builder background option 3 (lilac). Same in both themes so an avatar looks identical everywhere; initials on it use avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-bg-4

tokens.name: avatar-bg-6

tokens.name: avatar-ink

tokens.name: canvas-paper
tokens.usage: Drawing canvas background. Stays white in dark mode so drawings look the same to every player. Same in both themes; swatches carry a name tooltip and aria-label.

tokens.name: brush-black

tokens.name: brush-grey

tokens.name: arcade-sky
tokens.usage: Top of the arcade backdrop on the home page. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: arcade-sky-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the arcade backdrop, toward the horizon.

tokens.name: arcade-grid
tokens.usage: Neon grid lines and glows on the arcade backdrop. Decorative only.

tokens.name: arcade-glow
tokens.usage: Second neon accent on the arcade backdrop: the horizon and floating shapes. Decorative only.

tokens.name: arcade-ink
tokens.usage: Text placed directly on the arcade backdrop. 4.5:1 or better on arcade-sky and arcade-sky-deep.
